questions.stem: An overloaded service can process 100 requests/s but receives 180/s. Which response protects latency for accepted requests?

options.label: A
options.text: Disable metrics

options.label: B
options.text: Reject excess load quickly with a clear retry signal

options.label: C
options.text: Queue all traffic indefinitely

options.label: D
options.text: Increase every timeout without capacity change

questions.workedSolution: Admission control keeps work bounded; excessive queues make every request slow.
